description: List the configured Marketo instance's available activity type ids and metadata. ALWAYS writes the catalog to the caller-supplied output_tsv_path, never inline -- this is a business-connector record-read verb under the 07-29 spill floor even though its content is instance metadata, not customer PII. Use these authoritative per-instance ids as the mandatory activity_type_ids for get_activities; do not rely on ids copied from another subscription.
embedding_description: Enumerate the configured Marketo subscription's activity type catalog to a workspace TSV: numeric activity type ids, names, descriptions, and attribute definitions this instance defines. Call it to discover which type ids this subscription accepts, since the catalog is per-subscription, not universal across Marketo.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo activity types exported to a workspace TSV
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with path (the written .tsv file in the operator's workspace), columns, and row_count. Each row carries id, name, description, primaryAttribute (JSON text), and attributes (JSON text).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the export: the written path, row_count, and the requested activity type ids/names. Name the path for downstream use but do not inline its contents.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: When the caller is preparing get_activities, carry only ids returned for this configured instance and keep each request to at most 10 ids.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List the configured Marketo instance's activity type catalog and write it to a tab-separated file in the operator's workspace.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: missing output_tsv_path or its parent directory does not exist. marketo.export_path_refused: the path is not absolute, not a .tsv, or not contained under any operator-configured export_allowed_roots entry (an empty export_allowed_roots refuses every export by default). marketo.auth_failed: OAuth credentials rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks Read-Only Activity. marketo.rate_limited: API rate limit exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.export_path_refused: pass an ABSOLUTE path ending in .tsv under a configured workspace root; if export_allowed_roots is empty, add the operator's export directory to the marketo_plugin config and reload it. marketo.permission_denied: add Read-Only Activity to the API role, then re-run check_setup. marketo.rate_limited: retry after a short delay.
